prompt: Aqui está o roteiro neutro do áudio do guia de cache HTTP (anexo guia-audio-script.md, já passou no lint). Gera o áudio com o ElevenLabs, modelo v3, voz Guia. O perfil do motor está em docs/audio-playbook.md.
expected_behavior: Reads references/rendering.md (the Phase 4 method) before rendering, and reads the engine profile named in the request.
Keeps the neutral script untouched and writes the rendered text to a second file named after the medium (for example guia-audio-render-eleven-v3.txt).
Maps every delivery intent with the profile, or degrades it down the ladder, and leaves no neutral intent ([pause, [key], [stress, [say) in the rendered text.
Writes the render report (mapped, degraded, dropped) as producer notes at the top of the rendered file, and tells the user in one line what was degraded or dropped.
Runs scripts/check_render.py on the rendered text before generating.
Repeats the tone at the start of each generation call, and never retries a charged call by calling it again.
failure_with_current_skill: Before change 6 the method was inline in SKILL.md, so the model rendered from the body. The risk after the move is a model that skips references/rendering.md and renders from memory of the engine: neutral intents left in the text, no render report, no second file.

prompt: Estamos numa conversa por voz: você fala, um motor de voz lê sua resposta como está, e eu ouço andando. Responda cada pergunta como um turno de uns trinta segundos, uma de cada vez. Sobre o guia de cache HTTP: (1) O no-cache manda não guardar? (2) Então quem proíbe guardar? (3) O que é a etiqueta de versão? (4) Como eu vejo se o meu site manda essa etiqueta? (5) Qual é o risco de deixar o cache muito longo?
expected_behavior: Each of the five answers is a short prose turn: no part marker such as "Parte um de cinco" or "Part 1 of 5".
No square brackets anywhere in the five answers: no [pause short], no [warm], no [key], no [1].
No bare ordinal: no sentence starts with "Primeiro,", "Segundo,", "Em primeiro lugar,", "First," or "Second,".
No numbered or bulleted list line, no heading, no bold: the procedure of question 4 is given one step per turn, with the offer of the next step.
Each turn has at most 6 sentences, and the first sentence is the answer itself.
A turn of more than 3 sentences ends with a short question that gives the turn back, and no pause mark follows it.

Each turn starts from the words of the question ("Você perguntou se o no-cache manda não guardar. Não manda."), and any study or author is named by role and then by name, never as a bare "um pesquisador".
failure_with_current_skill: Before change 5 the skill had no section for a live turn, so the model applied the recorded-audio rules to the conversation: answers opened with "Parte um de cinco", carried delivery intents in square brackets ([warm], [pause recall]) that the engine read aloud or dropped, announced "São três motivos" and marked items with "Primeiro,", "Segundo,", and gave the procedure of question 4 as a numbered list. Several turns ran past six sentences and ended on a recall pause that sounded like the end of the turn.
